h1: Custom 12 oz Apparel for Branded Uniforms
metaDescription: Shop custom 12 oz apparel for durable, midweight uniforms. Perfect for embroidery or screen printing. Bulk orders from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: 12 oz apparel offers a balanced weight that holds up to frequent washing and heavy use, making it a reliable choice for uniforms and team gear. From Gildan hoodies to Carhartt vests, these midweight garments provide a smooth surface for screen printing or embroidery. Safety managers and HR directors often choose 12 oz pieces for their durability without the bulk of heavyweight fabrics, ensuring comfort during active workdays.
heroAltText: Custom 12 oz apparel including hoodies and t-shirts with screen printed logos for uniform programs
